collision_boundaries: Do not edit AGENTS.md or governance policy in this harness lane.
Do not absorb the separate Android/Herdr migration lane.
Do not mutate First Mate upstream or install dependencies from this harness.
One active writer per branch; First Mate workers require isolated branches/worktrees.
Do not treat Android readiness as a dependency for productive laptop/WSL crew work.
Do not parse WSL stderr as machine-readable stdout or depend on wslpath for Windows temporary-path transport.
Do not run Linux Git inside a Windows-created linked worktree; create a WSL-owned standalone exact-head clone from the clean committed source repository.
Do not execute the runtime through an implicit WSL default distribution; select and record an explicit bash+git-capable distribution first.
Do not pass raw Windows/PowerShell multiline command text to bash -lc; normalize CRLF and CR to LF at the bridge boundary.
Do not reject empty native stdout/stderr at PowerShell parameter binding; stream helpers must accept empty strings and decide semantics inside the function body.
proof_ceiling: Tracked harness structure, deterministic route selection, report generation, hosted validators, explicit WSL distribution selection, LF-normalized PowerShell-to-bash command transport, empty-native-stream-safe bridge helpers, and Windows-to-WSL standalone-clone bridge contract. Physical-laptop bridge execution, live First Mate crew dispatch, and Herdr runtime remain unproved.
